description: This file contains unit tests for the Consistent Ring Provider in an Orleans cluster. It verifies silo behavior during failures and joins, including scenarios like silo failure, recovery, and key responsibility verification. The tests utilize the Xunit framework and include configurations for in-memory storage and reminder services.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProviderTests_Silo
classes.description: Unit tests for the Consistent Ring Provider, testing silo failure and join scenarios within an Orleans cluster environment.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with in-memory grain storage and in-memory reminder service.

methods.name: FailureTest
methods.description: Performs failure simulations on silos and verifies cluster stability and key responsibilities.

methods.name: JoinTest
methods.description: Tests silo joining behavior and cluster stabilization.

methods.name: PickKey
methods.description: Picks a key assuming a specific silo is responsible for it based on consistent hashing.

methods.name: VerifyKey
methods.description: Verifies that a specific key is mapped to the correct silo responsible for it.

methods.name: getSilosToFail
methods.description: Determines which silos to fail based on the specified fail mode.

methods.name: printSilos
methods.description: Outputs the list of active silos for debugging.

methods.name: AssertEventually
methods.description: Retries assertions until success or timeout.
